newsitem.title: USA: Quality Food to merge with Hughes Family.
newsitem.headline: Quality Food to merge with Hughes Family.

text.p: Quality Food Centers Inc said on Wednesday it has signed a definitive merger pact to acquire Hughes Family Markets for $360 million in cash.

Both Huges and Quality Food's existing operations in Washington will operate as separate business units under a holding company, the company said, adding that Hughes' management and store employees will remain in place.
Hughes is a privately held retail grocery chain in the southern California marketplace with annual revenues of about $1 billion, the company said.
The company said the deal is expected to be completed in early 1997, subject to certain conditions including regulatory approval.
